note: Anthropic's error answers for the cases that cannot be produced on demand: credit used up, spend limits, rate limits, overload and server errors. Status, error type and the envelope (type, error, request_id) are as Anthropic's error and rate-limit pages show them. Where a page quotes no message, the message is illustrative: the code reads the status, the error type and error.details.error_code, and a message only to tell the two account 400s apart. The 401 and the 404 are recorded instead (bad-key.json and unknown-model.json, by scripts/record-anthropic-errors.ts).

credit_balance.source: Anthropic's answer once prepaid credit runs out: a 400 invalid_request_error naming the credit balance. The docs pages quote no message; this is the text #40's tests carried, and the code keys on "credit balance" alone.

error.message: Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API. Please go to Plans & Billing to upgrade or purchase credits.
There is an issue with your billing or payment information.
Your API key does not have permission to use the specified resource.

spend_limit.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits#setting-your-own-spend-limit (a 400 invalid_request_error whose message starts with this text and states when access resumes)

error.message: You have reached your specified API usage limits. You will regain access on 2026-12-01 at 00:00 UTC.
You have reached your specified workspace API usage limits. You will regain access on 2026-12-01 at 00:00 UTC.
You have reached your API usage limits: your organization has crossed its monthly API usage threshold, set based on your organization's API tier. You will regain access on 2026-09-01 at 00:00 UTC.
This request would exceed your organization's rate limit of 50,000 input tokens per minute.

rate_limited_no_retry_after.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits (not every 429 carries retry-after, such as an acceleration limit; message illustrative)

error.message: Your organization's usage increased sharply; slow down and try again.
Request exceeds the maximum allowed number of bytes.

invalid_request.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors (a 400 about the request itself, as quoted there)

error.message: This model does not support assistant message prefill. The conversation must end with a user message.
